run_eval_model_pca: run eval_model to extract features and compute separate and joint PCA visualizations for a neural network model
run_eval_model_dict_learning: run eval_model with do_dict_learning enabled to compute dictionary learning visualizations using RGB, RGB-CMY, and tab10 colormaps
create_PIL_heatmap: create a PIL heatmap image from a numpy array or torch tensor with a configurable colormap and normalization range
create_build_rgb: create an RGB image from PCA-projected feature components by normalizing and reshaping the first three components
create_PIL_make_grid: create a grid layout of PIL images with configurable padding and background color for visualization compositing
